                CONFIDENTIAL-FILING MEMORANDUM
TO:            Administrative Law Judge Rachelle Nicolette Robles, Central Records

FROM;          Southwestern Electric Power Company (SWEPCO)

DATE:          July 27, 2026

RE:            Docket No. 58796; SOAH Docket Number 473-26-07507– Application of
               Southwestern Electric Power Company for Authority to Amend Tariffs for Retail
               Service to Include New Standard Form Contract for Electric Service – Large Load


Southwestern Electric Power Company (SWEPCO) designates certain information provided in its
filed Rebuttal Testimonies as partially confidential.

This filing includes documents provided as Workpapers to the Rebuttal Testimony of SWEPCO
witness Lynn M. Ferry-Nelson that contain certain designated protected material originally
produced in response to discovery in pending PUCT Docket No. 58819 and now being produced
in this case. The designated material referenced as TIEC 14-2 Highly Sensitive Attachment 2S -
Supplemental is Highly Sensitive and is being reproduced without changes. The Highly Sensitive
Material included in this filing is located on pages 15, 19-22, 26, 30-33, 37, and 41-44.

The following pages contain redactions for the reasons stated below:
           TIEC 14-2 Highly Sensitive Attachment 2S – Supplemental
               o Pages 15, 19-22, 26, 30-33, 37, and 41-44
        This redacted attachment concerns non-public commercially sensitive data that includes
customer-identifying and usage data, the disclosure of which could cause substantial competitive
harm to SWEPCO and implicate third party privacy concerns, and is protected under the Public
Utility Regulatory Act (PURA) as highly sensitive trade secret information. The legal bases for
protection include PURA § 32.101, Texas Gov’t Code §§ 552.101 and 552.110.


Select the appropriate box below:
